assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md contains all four required sections using the exact heading formats from bug-template-mock.md: '### **Issue Description**' (line 26), '### **Steps to Reproduce**' (line 35), '### **Expected Result**' (line 43), '### **Actual Result**' (line 49). The template specifies these exact heading formats and all four are present with correct content extracted beneath each.

assertion_results.text: Bug validation confirms the issue type ID (10020) matches the Bug issue type ID from Bug Configuration (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md line 18: 'Bug issue type ID: 10020 (matches issue type)'. The issue metadata at line 7 also confirms 'Issue Type: Bug (ID: 10020)'. The Configuration Validated section explicitly states the ID matches.

assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause — line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md lines 20-21: 'At step 3, `line[3:]` does NOT strip trailing whitespace. When the heading line is `## Migration Patterns  \n`, the extracted key becomes `"Migration Patterns  "` (with two trailing spaces).' Line 46: 'section_name = line[3:]  # BUG: does not strip trailing whitespace'. The root cause is explicitly identified as line[3:] not stripping whitespace.

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md covers all three: WHAT - lines 9-15 explain 'extracts CONVENTIONS.md section headings using `line[3:]`, which preserves trailing whitespace'; WHERE - lines 19-20 specify 'plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/plan-feature/SKILL.md -- convention conformance analysis section, heading extraction logic'; HOW TO VERIFY - lines 36-44 describe reproducer strategy: 'Create a test fixture CONVENTIONS.md that includes a heading with trailing whitespace... Run the convention conformance analysis against this fixture and assert that the convention IS matched'.

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST acceptance criterion — before any fix criteria (Step 5 Acceptance Criteria ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md Acceptance Criteria section (lines 76-79): First criterion is '[ ] Reproducer test: a test with a CONVENTIONS.md fixture containing trailing whitespace on headings demonstrates the bug (fails before fix, passes after fix)'. This precedes the fix criteria: convention matching (line 77), Implementation Notes inclusion (line 78), and regression (line 79).

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST test requirement — with explicit assertion guidance derived from the Steps to Reproduce (Step 5 Test Requirements ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md Test Requirements section (line 82): First requirement is 'Reproducer test: create a test using a CONVENTIONS.md fixture with trailing whitespace on section headings (e.g., `## Migration Patterns  ` with trailing spaces). Assert that the convention IS matched and included in the generated task output. Before the fix, this test must fail (convention silently dropped). After the fix, it must pass (convention included in Implementation Notes as `Per CONVENTIONS.md Migration Patterns: add Index::create() for all FK columns.`).' This includes explicit assertion text derived from the Steps to Reproduce and Expected Result.

assertion_results.text: Task description includes a Bug Context section with Bug key (ACME-500), Steps to Reproduce, Expected/Actual Result, and Root Cause summary (Step 5 Bug Context extension)
